title: Huktup — Service Provider Operations & Scheduling Platform
subtitle: RESTful Laravel API, Reactive Vue.js + Chart.js Dashboard & Twilio SMS Automation
summary: Centralized scheduling and business operations platform for service providers with a Laravel RESTful API, reactive Vue.js/Chart.js analytics, Firebase SSO, and Twilio SMS client automation.
overview: In the local service sector, decentralized booking, payment collection, and manual customer follow-ups create severe operational roadblocks for business owners. Huktup was engineered to resolve this friction by offering an all-in-one operations hub. The platform centers around a high-performance RESTful API in Laravel (PHP) orchestrating reservations and finances, paired with a reactive analytical dashboard in Vue.js and Chart.js, automated SMS reminders and review collection via the Twilio API, and secure authentication via Firebase SSO.
responsibilities: Core API Development: Built the centralized Laravel RESTful API governing service catalogs, staff scheduling, and payment events.
Analytical Dashboard: Developed the responsive Vue.js frontend with Chart.js visualization for business revenue, client retention, and booking trends.
Third-Party Integrations: Implemented bidirectional SMS conversational flows via the Twilio API and secure onboarding via Firebase Auth (SSO).
API Documentation & DevOps: Standardized complete OpenAPI/Swagger specifications and containerized application services using Docker.

challengesAndSolutions.challenge: Minimizing customer no-shows through scalable, reliable bidirectional SMS communication.
challengesAndSolutions.solution: Engineered automated messaging rules with Twilio handling booking confirmations, 24h reminders, and instant post-service feedback collection.

challengesAndSolutions.challenge: Accelerating parallel collaboration between frontend, backend, and QA teams without contract drifts.
challengesAndSolutions.solution: Authored comprehensive OpenAPI/Swagger documentation, eliminating contract ambiguity and facilitating automated API testing.
